sql:
SELECT p.uid,p.name,p.latitude,p.longitude,p.photo,(length(p.photo)>0) AS has_photo,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.enabled,1)=0 THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE COALESCE(s.status,'IDLE') END AS status,
 s.updated_at,COALESCE(s.node_id,'') AS node_id,COALESCE(s.event_id,'') AS last_event_id,
 COALESCE(c.enabled,1) AS enabled
 FROM profiles p LEFT JOIN profile_controls c ON c.group_id=p.group_id AND c.uid=p.uid
 LEFT JOIN presence s ON s.group_id=p.group_id AND s.uid=p.uid
 WHERE p.group_id=$group AND COALESCE(c.deleted,0)=0 ORDER BY p.name,p.uid

sql:
INSERT INTO profiles(group_id,uid,name,photo,latitude,longitude,created_at)
 VALUES($group,$uid,$name,$photo,$lat,$lng,$now)
 ON CONFLICT(group_id,uid) DO UPDATE SET name=excluded.name,photo=excluded.photo,
 latitude=excluded.latitude,longitude=excluded.longitude,created_at=excluded.created_at
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profile_controls c WHERE c.group_id=$group AND c.uid=$uid AND c.deleted=1)
 RETURNING uid
name: SQLite - Pendaftaran

sql:
INSERT INTO scan_events(group_id,event_id,uid,node_id,status,scanned_at)
 SELECT $group,$event,$uid,$node,CASE WHEN s.status='CHECK_IN' THEN 'CHECK_OUT' ELSE 'CHECK_IN' END,$now
 FROM profiles p LEFT JOIN profile_controls c ON c.group_id=p.group_id AND c.uid=p.uid
 LEFT JOIN presence s ON s.group_id=p.group_id AND s.uid=p.uid
 WHERE p.group_id=$group AND p.uid=$uid AND COALESCE(c.enabled,1)=1 AND COALESCE(c.deleted,0)=0 AND (s.updated_at IS NULL OR $now-s.updated_at>=2000)
 ON CONFLICT(group_id,event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING uid,status,scanned_at,
 (SELECT name FROM profiles WHERE profiles.group_id=scan_events.group_id AND profiles.uid=scan_events.uid) AS name
name: SQLite - Scan atomik

sql:
SELECT p.uid AS registered_uid,COALESCE(c.enabled,1) AS enabled,COALESCE(c.deleted,0) AS deleted,e.uid AS event_uid,e.status AS event_status,e.scanned_at,
 COALESCE(s.status,'IDLE') AS status FROM (SELECT 1) seed
 LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.group_id=$group AND p.uid=$uid
 LEFT JOIN profile_controls c ON c.group_id=$group AND c.uid=$uid
 LEFT JOIN presence s ON s.group_id=$group AND s.uid=$uid
 LEFT JOIN scan_events e ON e.group_id=$group AND e.event_id=$event

 FROM scan_events e LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.group_id=e.group_id AND p.uid=e.uid

sql:
INSERT INTO profile_controls(group_id,uid,enabled,deleted)
 SELECT $group,$uid,$enabled,0 WHERE EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM profiles p LEFT JOIN profile_controls c ON c.group_id=p.group_id AND c.uid=p.uid
 WHERE p.group_id=$group AND p.uid=$uid AND COALESCE(c.deleted,0)=0)
 ON CONFLICT(group_id,uid) DO UPDATE SET enabled=excluded.enabled WHERE profile_controls.deleted=0
 RETURNING uid

sql:
INSERT INTO profile_controls(group_id,uid,enabled,deleted)
 SELECT $group,$uid,0,1 WHERE EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM profiles p LEFT JOIN profile_controls c ON c.group_id=p.group_id AND c.uid=p.uid
 WHERE p.group_id=$group AND p.uid=$uid AND COALESCE(c.deleted,0)=0)
 ON CONFLICT(group_id,uid) DO UPDATE SET enabled=0,deleted=1 WHERE profile_controls.deleted=0
 RETURNING uid
